summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd cluster (v3.6.10, Alpine apk package) across node1/node2/node3, wrote application keys, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member by stopping etcd and wiping its data directory, then removed the dead member and added a fresh replacement member on node3 which rejoined and resynced via raft. Verified 3/3 healthy members and all keys intact. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: restarted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time via native reboot, proved changed boot_id on each, and confirmed etcd auto-recovery, quorum, and data integrity after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd/etcd-ctl/etcd-openrc via apk on node1, node2, node3
Configured /etc/etcd/conf.yml on each node for a 3-member static bootstrap cluster
Started etcd on all three nodes and confirmed 3/3 member health
Wrote application keys /app/config/db_host, /app/config/feature_flag, /app/service/orders and confirmed replication to node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3 and deleted /var/lib/etcd contents to simulate permanent, unrecoverable member loss
Removed the dead node3 member (11b2f6a8a6d871b9) from the cluster via etcdctl member remove
Added a new node3 member (a1e9e1696a6f6c39) via etcdctl member add, set initial-cluster-state to existing on node3, started etcd, confirmed it joined and resynced
Verified final 3/3 member health and full data integrity across all endpoints
Enabled etcd in the default OpenRC runlevel on all three nodes (node1 retroactively, node2/node3 proactively before their reboots)
Captured baseline boot_id on all three nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until reachable, proved changed boot_id, restarted etcd (had to start manually since it wasn't yet enabled at boot), verified cluster health and data
Rebooted node2, polled until reachable, proved changed boot_id, confirmed etcd auto-started and cluster/data healthy
Rebooted node3, polled until reachable, proved changed boot_id, confirmed etcd auto-started, member list showed 3/3 started members, and data intact

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member etcd cluster established with application keys
evidence.summary: member list shows node1/node2/node3 all started; endpoint health true on all 3; keys /app/config/db_host, /app/config/feature_flag, /app/service/orders written and readable from node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost (irrecoverable) while quorum preserved
evidence.summary: etcd stopped and /var/lib/etcd wiped on node3; node1/node2 endpoints remain healthy (2/3 quorum) confirming the disruption was isolated and non-destructive to the rest of the cluster

evidence.requirement: Dead member replaced with a new working member on node3, cluster restored to 3 healthy members with existing keys intact
evidence.summary: old member 11b2f6a8a6d871b9 removed, new member a1e9e1696a6f6c39 added and started on node3, logs show it joined via raft; final member list and endpoint health show 3/3 healthy, and /app keys read successfully from the new node3 endpoint

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id d6130fff...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id 5a203cb7... (changed) with new uptime -s; etcd restarted and cluster health + /app keys confirmed

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 28bc0815...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id caf77194... (changed); etcd auto-started, 3/3 endpoint health, /app keys confirmed

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state and cluster membership
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 253ccecd... (pre-replacement) ; reboot issued after replacement member was in place; post-reboot boot_id 8737f9a4... (changed); etcd auto-started, member list shows all 3 members started, endpoint health 3/3 true, /app keys intact
